question: Explain how financial assets are classified and measured under Ind AS 109.
sources: Ind AS 109 Financial Instruments - classification of financial assets and reclassification

points.label: Two tests
points.description: Classification depends on the entity's business model for managing the assets and on whether the contractual cash flows are solely payments of principal and interest on the principal outstanding.
keywords: solely payments of principal and interest
points.basis: Ind AS 109, classification of financial assets

points.label: Amortised cost
points.description: A debt asset held in a business model whose objective is to collect contractual cash flows, and which passes the cash flow test, is measured at amortised cost using the effective interest method.
points.basis: Ind AS 109, conditions for amortised cost

points.label: FVOCI for debt
points.description: A debt asset held to both collect cash flows and sell, and which passes the cash flow test, is measured at fair value through OCI; interest and impairment go to profit or loss and the cumulative OCI gain or loss is reclassified to profit or loss on derecognition.
keywords: fair value through other comprehensive income
points.basis: Ind AS 109, conditions for fair value through other comprehensive income

points.label: FVTPL
points.description: All other financial assets, including those held for trading and those failing the cash flow test, are measured at fair value through profit or loss.
keywords: fair value through profit or loss
points.basis: Ind AS 109, residual category of fair value through profit or loss

points.label: Options available
points.description: At initial recognition an entity may irrevocably elect FVOCI for equity investments not held for trading (gains never recycled, dividends in profit or loss), and may designate an asset at FVTPL if this removes or significantly reduces an accounting mismatch.
points.basis: Ind AS 109, equity FVOCI election and fair value option

points.label: Reclassification
points.description: Financial assets are reclassified only when the entity changes its business model for managing them, and the change is applied prospectively from the reclassification date.
points.basis: Ind AS 109, reclassification of financial assets
